subject: Accounting for differences in reserve areas in "occuMulti"

messages.author: 5cdcd35ebb4b0d81
messages.subject: Accounting for differences in reserve areas in "occuMulti"
parts:
Hello,

I am attempting to use unmarked to model species interactions using the Rota et al. (2016) model while combining data from different reserves which vary in size. I was wondering if there is any way to account for the area size of different reserves in the multi-species occupancy models fitted with the occuMulti function so that the area size could be regarded as an offset = log(area) in the models. If not, are there any other ways to account for the area size of different reserves? I apologise if this is a foolish question.

Any insights would be greatly appreciated! Thank you in advance for your help!
